name: registration-software-pricing-index
title: Registration software pricing index: what 56 platforms publish about price, fees and nonprofit terms
description: What registration, camp, childcare, class and sports software publishes about plan prices, nonprofit offers, fees passed on to families, card processing rates, contracts, onboarding fees and Spanish-language support. Each record has a short summary of what the platform publishes, a link to the source and the date we checked.
cite_as: BackPR (2026). Registration software pricing index: what 56 platforms publish about price, fees and nonprofit terms (version 1.0, checked October 2026). https://backpr.com/data/registration-software-pricing-index.json. CC BY 4.0.
sources: Each company's public pricing pages and terms, linked from its BackPR comparison page
notes: BackPR competes with the companies in this index, so we left BackPR out. A value of "not published" means we found nothing, not that the company doesn't offer it. CC BY 4.0 covers BackPR's compilation; quoted company text remains the company's. Companies in the index can send corrections to support@backpr.com. BackPR's State of Youth Programs 2026 report uses only the 48 registration and management platforms in this index and leaves out the form, fundraising, event and membership tools (categories "forms" and "membership").
